verdict.rationale: Requiring a new device to be paired or explicitly approved is a fair question for a remote-desktop product, so the axis applies. The pack never documents an accept-connection prompt, a device allowlist, or pairing. The only related item is the CLI setting an unattended-access password, which is an adjacent control and not per-device approval or pairing.

support.subject: As a power user, a new device must be paired or explicitly approved before it can see or control the screen
